query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS murals (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  subjectId INT NOT NULL,
  classId INT NOT NULL,
  createdBy INT NOT NULL,
  isLocked BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  isActive BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mural_columns (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  muralId INT NOT NULL,
  title VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  icon VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '📌',
  color VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'green',
  position INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mural_cards (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  muralId INT NOT NULL,
  columnId INT NOT NULL,
  text TEXT NOT NULL,
  color VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'yellow',
  authorType ENUM('teacher','student') NOT NULL,
  authorUserId INT,
  authorStudentId INT,
  authorName VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  teacherReply TEXT,
  teacherReplyAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  isDeleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mural_votes (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  cardId INT NOT NULL,
  voterType ENUM('teacher','student') NOT NULL,
  voterUserId INT,
  voterStudentId INT,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
